newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.094pts to 103.410.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.094pts to 103.410.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.094 points in Monday's trading to 103.410 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.758 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.108 points to 100.917, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.371 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 2.517 points to 1,023.049.
